allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output "done")
Bash(timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done')
